description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing a notes application. It includes types for notes, context state functions, and implements core note management features such as creating, updating, deleting notes, and persisting data to localStorage.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Utility function to generate a unique identifier for a note.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React component providing notes context to its children, managing notes state with localStorage persistence.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom hook for accessing the notes context, enforcing usage within a NotesProvider.
